summary: BILI Social International, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that, effective October 2, 2026, it terminated Equiniti Trust Company LLC as transfer agent and appointed VStock Transfer, LLC as successor transfer agent and registrar, with all shareholder records transferred to VStock at 18 Lafayette Place, Woodmere, NY. The report is signed by CEO Adrian Capobianco and dated October 7, 2026. No securities are registered on any exchange. This is an administrative agent change, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
